title: What to Wear to an Interview: Dress Codes, Outfit Ideas, and What to Avoid
description:
Getting ready for a job interview? Deciding what to wear can be stressful, but we're here to make it easier! In this video, we'll guide you through the different dress codes, share outfit ideas for various types of interviews, and highlight common fashion mistakes to avoid. Whether it's a corporate setting, a casual startup, or a creative environment, we've got tips to help you look your best and make a great first impression.

In This Video:
 Understanding Dress Codes: Learn the differences between business formal, business casual, and casual dress codes.
 Outfit Ideas: Get inspired with outfit suggestions for men and women tailored to each dress code.
 What to Avoid: Discover the common pitfalls and fashion faux pas that could undermine your confidence and professionalism.
